novel.title: The Perfect Run II
novel.summary: Continuing directly from the first volume, immortal time-looper Ryan Romano (Quicksave) arrives in post-apocalyptic New Rome hunting the Meta-Gang and their cache of Mechron technology. This volume follows multiple regression loops as Ryan infiltrates Dynamis, forges uneasy alliances with the Carnival vigilantes, the Augusti crime family's daughter Livia, and eventually the Meta-Gang themselves. At the novel's heart is Ryan's quest to break his curse of solitude by developing a consciousness-transfer machine that lets others carry their memories across his time-resets. Midway through, the book pivots into a 'villain arc' where Ryan takes over the Meta-Gang as self-declared President, explores Mechron's bunker, communicates with a sentient Black Elixir called Darkling, briefly enters the Black World, and raids Dynamis' Lab Sixty-Six. The volume ends in catastrophe when Bloodstream—kept alive by Dynamis as the basis for their Knockoff Elixirs—is accidentally freed and triggers a near-extinction event, forcing another reset.
themes: the nature of Elixirs and higher dimensions

characters.name: Ryan Romano
characters.age: Biologically young adult; true age 500-1000+ years due to loops
characters.description: A handsome young man who favors dark purple cashmere suits, a silver-and-black metal mask, a bowler hat, and a wool clock-symbol scarf. Later dons a full black-and-red presidential costume and the Saturn power armor with rabbit-ear antennae.
characters.personality: Irreverently comedic, chronically quippy, and seemingly carefree, masking centuries of accumulated grief. Deeply empathetic despite his cynicism. Compulsively generous with second chances. Terrified of genuine connection but desperately craves it. Holds to his word even when no one will remember it.
characters.background: Adoptive son of Bloodstream (Freddie Sabino). Raised alongside Len Sabino in post-apocalyptic Italy as a captive under the Psycho's care. Bonded a Violet Elixir to escape Bloodstream, gained the ability to freeze time and create save-points. Spent a subjective century trapped in Monaco's pocket dimension. Has lived through countless loops.
characters.current_power_level: Violet Genome with emerging Black Flux secondary; boosted to peak by the Saturn Armor

power_progression.chapter: Ch. Past Fragment: The First Run

power_progression.stage: Saturn Armor amplified Violet Flux + Black Flux emergence

special_abilities: Time-Stop: freezes all time for ~10 seconds with equal cooldown (armor extends duration)
Save Point: creates a fixed moment in time to which he returns upon death
Purple World access: can perceive the Violet dimension in stopped time
Black Flux: after entering the Black World, generates paradox particles that devour Red Flux
Enhanced sense of timing from Elixir guidance

characters.name: Len Sabino
characters.description: Slight young woman with black hair and blue eyes. Usually wears a brown jumpsuit and carries a water rifle. Later wears a Genius-built diving power armor based on Vulcan's design.
characters.personality: Chronically introverted and prone to depression, self-medicating with antidepressants. Highly intelligent. Slow to trust but fiercely loyal once she does. Shows sardonic wit and dry humor with Ryan. Harbors deep grief and denial regarding her father Bloodstream.
characters.background: Biological daughter of Freddie Sabino/Bloodstream. Raised alongside Ryan as captive 'children' of the Psycho. A Genius-class Blue Genome. After her father's death at the Carnival's hands, hid in an underwater habitat and has raised a group of orphans including Sarah. Keeps herself cut off from the surface world.
characters.current_power_level: Blue Genius with advanced underwater tech mastery

power_progression.stage: Bonded Blue Elixir as teenager; father immediately detected it
power_progression.chapter: Ch. Past Fragment: The First Run

special_abilities: Genius-level intellect specialized in submarine and underwater habitat technology
Water Rifle: fires pressurized water streams capable of forming impenetrable suspended-animation bubble prisons
Chronoradio: can construct and operate advanced communication technology capable of transmitting signals across time
Consciousness Transfer Machine: developed to send a memory-map of a person back in time to overwrite their past self

characters.name: Livia Augusti
characters.description: Platinum-haired young woman of regal bearing. Wears a black Dior suit and Daft Punk-style red-black helmet as Queen Crimson. Carries golden bracelets and Fisty Brothers gauntlets when in the field.
characters.personality: Deeply analytical, composed to a fault, and emotionally guarded. Harbors enormous pressure from her father's expectations. Deeply principled yet trapped in moral compromise. Becomes more playful and open around Ryan, one of the few people her power cannot read.
characters.background: Daughter of Augustus, the warlord-godfather of Italy. Drank a Blue Elixir first, then a Violet one, gaining two stable powers due to a rare genetic quirk. Was in a politically-arranged relationship with Felix Veran. Maintains a 'Blue Room' where she archives notes from alternate timelines to communicate across Ryan's resets.

power_progression.stage: Blue Elixir first; then Violet - stable dual Genome

special_abilities: Parallel Sight: can observe up to six alternate realities simultaneously through a shared hub
Temporal Anomaly: creates a localized time-skip zone where she acts freely while others follow a script
Blue Room Archive: a psychic space where she stores notes that persist across Ryan's timeline resets
Exceptional political and social intelligence

characters.name: Felix Veran
characters.description: Handsome young man with short brown hair and blue eyes. His facial features are suspiciously perfect, possibly enhanced by his mother Venus. Wears a gymnast-style white costume with dart bandolier.
characters.personality: Principled and stubborn. Hot-tempered but fundamentally decent. Struggles with rage at his family's crimes. Loyal to a fault once trust is earned.
characters.background: Son of Mars and Venus of the Augusti. Left the family after witnessing what Bliss did to Chitter/Ki-jung. Joined Dynamis' Il Migliore to fight the Augusti. Later joins the Carnival. His arranged relationship with Livia never held genuine romantic feeling on his side.
special_abilities: Charges solid matter with explosive energy using his touch
Can modulate explosion power and add a time-delay
Uses pebbles and darts as devastating projectiles

characters.name: Yukiko
characters.description: Japanese woman of stunning beauty and infectiously cheerful demeanor. Changes her appearance constantly via her power.
characters.personality: Bubbly, enthusiastic, and relentlessly warm. Passionate about fashion. Deeply kind-hearted. Bisexual and in a civil union with Nora Moore. Becomes Ryan's self-declared archenemy.
characters.background: Senior Il Migliore junior hero about to graduate to Pro League. Has a Genius-made techno-organic symbiote costume. In a relationship with Nora Moore the city-planning Genius.
special_abilities: Can transform into any persona ingrained in mankind's collective consciousness
Gains abilities associated with that persona
Power of persona scales with how well-defined the collective idea of them is
Has a secret Apocalypse Suit of near-world-destroying power
If persona is worn too long she begins to mentally become that person

characters.name: Timmy
characters.description: In human form, a large naive-looking man with big hopeful eyes. In panda form, a 700 kg giant panda who hits like a freight train. Wears a shirtless costume with two bullet bandoliers, green beret, black shorts, and sunglasses.
characters.personality: Pure of heart, enthusiastic, easily overwhelmed by emotion. Worships Ryan as a master and mentor figure. Surprisingly competent in battle despite comedic disposition.
characters.background: Drank a Green Elixir and became a were-panda, unable to eat meat. Was nearly rejected by Dynamis before Ryan sponsored him. Became an immediate meme sensation. His panda form allows full biological regeneration when shapeshifting.
special_abilities: Transforms into a 700 kg giant panda with proportional strength and resilience
Fully regenerates injuries when switching between human and panda form
Enhanced strength and durability in both forms

characters.name: Enrique Manada
characters.description: Immaculately dressed in a cashmere suit always bearing a rose. Poised, controlled, and deliberate in all actions.
characters.personality: Coldly professional with hidden moral fiber. Genuinely believes in Dynamis' mission to rebuild civilization. Capable of ruthless pragmatism but draws lines at unnecessary cruelty. Subtly protective of innocents.
characters.background: CBO and Head Manager of Il Migliore at Dynamis. Son of CEO Hector Manada. Grew increasingly disturbed by his father's corruption. Co-orchestrates a corporate coup alongside Alphonse after Ryan provides evidence. Warned Ryan to leave New Rome before Alphonse could go after Len.
special_abilities: Commands and grows any plant at will
His rose reacts to his emotional state
Can create plant-based toxins; used genetically modified aconitine to neutralize Psyshock
Vines spread through buildings as surveillance and attack vectors

characters.name: Alphonse Manada
characters.description: A towering colossus nearly two-and-a-half meters tall, encased in black power armor. His flesh radiates crimson nuclear energy, leaving his bones visible through his skin like an X-ray. The glass dome of his helmet reveals a glowing skull.
characters.personality: Coldly idealistic. Genuinely believes in Dynamis' mission to democratize power. No patience for sentimentality. Reminds Ryan of Augustus in his willingness to see enemies as expendable.
characters.background: VP of Dynamis. Son of Hector Manada. Exiled to Sicily after dropping a nuclear bomb on Augustus in a failed assassination attempt. Returned to oust his father. Wants to mass-produce Elixirs to make power democratic. Killed several of Ryan's allies in his final loop.
special_abilities: Body has become a living nuclear reactor; emits lethal radiation passively
Energy minigun integrated into right arm
Rocket launchers in shoulder armor
Can generate focused gamma-ray particle beams powerful enough to vaporize matter
Can override safeties to become a walking nuclear explosion

characters.name: Hector Manada
characters.description: A pudgy man with gray hair resembling Pablo Escobar. Favors casual white clothes and a straw hat at home.
characters.personality: Pragmatic to the point of moral bankruptcy. Believes in outlasting threats rather than confronting them. Will not fight when he can negotiate or bide.
characters.background: CEO of Dynamis. Secretly hired the Meta-Gang to harass the Augusti. Allowed Dr. Tyrano to use Bloodstream's essence to create Knockoff Elixirs. Was creating a brain-copying project with Psyshock. Ousted by his sons Alphonse and Enrique.

characters.name: Wyvern
characters.description: Can transform into a dragon. Wears a leotard-style hero costume. In a long-running on-and-off relationship with Blackthorn.
characters.personality: Sincere and principled but initially naive about Dynamis' corruption. Willing to do the right thing at great cost once she has proof.
characters.background: Leader of Il Migliore. Provides templates for a Hercules Knockoff Elixir. After Ryan's revelations are confirmed, publicly resigns from Il Migliore on live TV. Her clone is found in Lab Sixty-Six being used as an organ processor.
special_abilities: Transforms into a large dragon
Breath weapon and flight
Enhanced physical capabilities in both forms

characters.name: Adam Fontaine
characters.description: A grotesquely overweight man covered in a carbon alloy when powered up. Deceptively jovial and eloquent given his murderous nature.
characters.personality: Nihilistic hedonist. Pretends to be a foolish buffoon but is deeply cunning. Manipulative. His ultimate goal is to destroy the world with the Bahamut orbital laser.
characters.background: Cannibalistic serial killer from Brooklyn who escaped to Europe before Last Easter. Gained Orange and Violet powers. Leader of the Meta-Gang. Discovered Mechron's bunker through a captured research probe. Hired by Hector Manada to harass the Augusti while secretly planning to betray Dynamis. Was killed when the Black Elixir consumed him.
characters.cultivation_path: Orange/Violet Psycho (Carbon Armor + Pocket Dimension Stomach)
special_abilities: Turns skin into a highly-resistant carbon alloy
Enhanced strength from carbon form
Pocket dimension stomach capable of storing almost anything
Tactical genius and master manipulator

characters.name: Francis Grey
characters.description: A horrifying figure composed almost entirely of nerve-like brain tissue and wire-like tendrils, like a humanoid squid.
characters.personality: Cold, sociopathic, and possessive. Takes sadistic pleasure in violating minds. Arrogant about his immortality but shows genuine strategic cunning.
characters.background: Second-in-command of the Meta-Gang. Can project his consciousness into any human host via tendrils, making him effectively immortal. Sabotaged the brain-copying machine with a booby trap that enslaved all recipients. Killed permanently by Mortimer's bullet while Enrique's aconitine kept him unconscious.
special_abilities: Body is almost entirely made of nerve tissue and tentacles
Can project consciousness into and take over any nearby human host upon death
Telepathy and memory reading
Booby-trapped the consciousness-transfer device to make any overwritten mind his slave

characters.name: Jasmine Sharif
characters.description: Short, fierce, and fearlessly competent. Designs and operates advanced power armor. Has a playful innuendo-laden rapport with Ryan.
characters.personality: Fierce, independent, and deeply grudge-holding toward Dynamis. Motivated by spite and genuine love of destruction. Pragmatic but has moral lines she will not cross.
characters.background: A weapon Genius formerly associated with the Augusti. In an earlier loop she and Ryan had a genuine romantic relationship; she was killed by the Bahamut. This Vulcan doesn't remember their relationship but shares the same personality. Designs the Saturn Armor for Ryan. Her clone is found in Lab Sixty-Six.
special_abilities: Genius-level intellect specializing in power armor, weapons, and military technology
Designs armors capable of withstanding Genome-level combat
Hacks Dynamis anti-aerial systems effortlessly (she designed them)
Creates the Saturn Armor capable of amplifying Violet Flux

characters.name: Leonard Hargraves
characters.description: In hero form, a humanoid figure made of blinding golden-white plasma. In human form, a warm and dignified man.
characters.personality: Sincere, noble to a fault, and heartbroken over past failures. Carries immense guilt. Refuses to compromise on principles.
characters.background: Leader of the Carnival. A longtime nemesis of Augustus. Killed Bloodstream in the past-fragment flashback. Works with Dynamis in most loops to assault the Meta-Gang and later to contain Bloodstream's outbreak.
special_abilities: Can become a living star; generates plasma, light, and immense heat
Moves at fighter-jet speed in solar form
Near-invulnerable in star form
Can incinerate matter at the molecular level

characters.name: Mathias Martel
characters.description: Can turn invisible, leaving only scattered glass shards visible when using power. Lives in a shack full of computer servers.
characters.personality: Paranoid, principled, and deeply haunted by his mother Pythia's death. Willing to commit extreme acts of violence against the Augusti. Grudgingly trusts Ryan.
characters.background: Son of Pythia, the Carnival's precognitive member. Joined the Carnival after his mother's dementia. Wages a covert bombing campaign against the Augusti. Lost his right arm to Acid Rain's grenade; recovered via Dr. Stitch.
special_abilities: Turns invisible (becomes translucent glass-like)
Telekinetically creates, shapes, and hurls glass shards
Can form glass barriers and constructs
Power reacts emotionally to stress

characters.name: Ace
characters.description: A roguish woman with freckles and long auburn hair. Usually arrives on or near an American motorcycle.
characters.personality: Confident, competent, and direct. Warm with teammates but businesslike in battle.
characters.background: The Carnival's main teleporter. Creates circular spatial rifts to allow troop movement. Died in a past-fragment loop when Bloodstream infected her while she was evacuating the Cossack.
special_abilities: Opens circular spatial rifts to any location she has visited
Can move groups of people quickly across large distances

characters.name: Greta
characters.description: Always wears a bright friendly smile regardless of context. Guards Livia's meeting spots. Unnervingly cheerful even while discussing lethal violence.
characters.personality: Terrifyingly sweet. Appears incapable of malice in affect while being entirely capable of lethal efficiency.
characters.background: A Killer Seven member assigned to protect Livia. Nullifies Elixir-dimension connections, preventing Genomes from drawing on their power sources. Cannot affect physical mutations. Augustus himself is immune. Confirmed that her power cannot permanently kill Ryan.
special_abilities: Disrupts the connection between Elixirs and their source dimensions, nullifying active powers
Cannot affect physical mutations caused by Elixirs
Makes Psyshock's body-transfer permanent death by preventing re-bonding

characters.name: Mortimer
characters.description: A world-weary assassin who can phase through solid matter. Wears a cloak and carries a rifle.
characters.personality: Cynical, efficient, and blunt. Fond of Fortuna despite her irritating qualities. Provides comic deadpan contrast to Ryan's flamboyance. Sent by Livia to save Ryan from Pluto.
characters.background: A Killer Seven member who serves Livia. Can phase through solid matter. Phased to shoot and kill Pluto when she had Ryan and Felix cornered. Livia's most trusted personal agent.
special_abilities: Phases through solid matter at will
Skilled marksmanship from phased positions
Can travel underground

characters.name: Fortuna Veran
characters.description: Blindingly beautiful with long golden hair. Wears outrageous golden outfits. Carries a gold-plated cell phone and later a gold-plated pistol.
characters.personality: Outwardly narcissistic and entitled to an extreme degree. Underneath, deeply sensitive about her sculpture work which she keeps private. Loves Livia with sisterly devotion and Felix with fierce protective loyalty.
characters.background: Daughter of Mars and Venus of the Augusti. Best friend and surrogate sister to Livia. Joins the Killer Seven to protect Livia. Studies applied arts and creates Renaissance-inspired sculptures secretly. Her luck power finally fails against Pluto but she sacrifices herself to save Felix, dying after killing Pluto.
special_abilities: Nearly everything that can go well for her, does
Wins lotteries and random draws with extreme reliability
Her luck briefly neutralized Pluto's death-curse near Felix

characters.name: Pluto
characters.description: Arrived in a black Lamborghini Gallardo. Composed and professional. An Underboss of the Killer Seven and Augusti elder.
characters.personality: Calm, efficient, and without hesitation. Treats assassination as professional obligation. Killed by Fortuna's lucky shot.
characters.background: Widowed. Given orders by Augustus to kill Felix for betraying the family. Her power can mark targets with a death-curse. At extreme proximity, the world itself conspires to kill her target. Killed by Fortuna after cornering both her and Felix.
special_abilities: Marks targets with a sympathetic death-curse
The closer she is to her target, the more severe the calamities
At extreme proximity, the world itself conspires to kill the target
Can only actively target one person at a time

characters.name: Richard Pinkman
characters.description: Wears a full black bodysuit covering him head to toe. His power activates in darkness.
characters.personality: Methodical and silent. Leverages his power to create traumatic illusions of his targets' worst fears.
characters.background: A Blue Genome member of the Killer Seven. Can create illusions that manifest as psychosomatic wounds. Attacked Ryan with illusions of Bloodstream and a dying Len during the forest chase. Killed by Ryan with a shot to the head in frozen time.
special_abilities: Creates illusions of targets' deepest fears that inflict real psychosomatic wounds
Power activates primarily in darkness
Illusions persist even through Ryan's time-stop

characters.name: Karen Ricci
characters.description: A strikingly beautiful redhead with a curvaceous figure. Wears a red leather jacket. Uses pheromones to manipulate targets.
characters.personality: Uses charm as a weapon, switching between seduction and violence efficiently. Genuinely surprised Ryan resisted her pheromones.
characters.background: The Vamp/Sparrow of the Killer Seven. A Green Genome whose pheromone-producing skin can cause extreme arousal or death on touch. Killed by Ryan during the forest chase.
special_abilities: Releases airborne pheromones causing extreme euphoria, compulsion, or attraction
Deadly pheromone smoke on inhalation
Touch causes vitals to fail
Wore a bulletproof vest

characters.name: Marco Veran
characters.age: Older adult; suffering from a brain tumor
characters.description: Keeps a constant electrical halo around himself. Moves at superhuman speed. His body appears to be composed of some superior form of metal. Increasingly reclusive.
characters.personality: Supremely narcissistic and entitled. Paranoid enough to murder anyone who might threaten him. Lets his tumor-addled mind drag him into personal vendettas even during world-ending crises.
characters.background: Warlord-godfather of Italy. Controls the Bliss drug trade across Europe. His wife Juno died in the crossfire of a Carnival attack. Has a brain tumor that may be as invulnerable as the rest of him. Has two Elixirs that coexist due to the same genetic quirk as Livia. Was distracted fighting the plushie swarm on Mount Augustus during the final loop's Bloodstream catastrophe.
characters.current_power_level: Orange/Red Dual Genome (Invulnerable Metal Body + Lightning)
characters.cultivation_path: Orange/Red Dual Genome (Invulnerable Crystalline Body + Electrical Mastery)
special_abilities: Body is composed of an anomalous metal-like substance that resists virtually all forms of damage
Can move in Ryan's frozen time
Commands lightning - crimson electrical bolts of enormous power
Superhuman strength; can punch through the Saturn Armor's chest weapon
Ryan's Black Flux briefly startled him - the only thing to do so

characters.name: Freddie Sabino
characters.description: No longer human. In his final state, a colossal dark-red protoplasmic shoggoth. In past flashbacks: a tired man with black hair and brown eyes.
characters.personality: In the past, glimpses of genuine love for his children alongside violent possessiveness and delusion. In the present, reduced to a purely viral instinct to spread and consume.
characters.background: Former municipal policeman. Stole two Elixirs on Last Easter. His Green/Blue powers mutated into a virus where each blood cell carries his consciousness. Killed by Leo Hargraves in a past loop. His remains were harvested by Dynamis and kept in Lab Sixty-Six as the basis for Knockoff Elixirs. Reconstituted and released in the final loop, triggering a near-extinction event.
special_abilities: Body is composed entirely of blood he controls telekinetically
Each blood cell carries his full consciousness - destruction of part does not kill him
Infects any human (and eventually any animal) who contacts his blood
In his final mutated form: no limit to mass, can spread globally
Can generate crystallized blood weapons and tentacles

characters.name: Alain Tyrano
characters.description: A two-meters-tall humanoid tyrannosaurus rex hybrid with black scales, crimson eyes, and a lab coat. Wears tiny glasses suited to his head shape. Has a pet Tricerador.
characters.personality: Single-minded obsession with dinosaurs and gene splicing. Completely indifferent to ethics in research. His true goal: turn every human into a dinosaur, consensually.
characters.background: Dynamis' head of science, responsible for Knockoff Elixir production. A Blue Genius who used an experimental serum to transform himself into a dinosaur. Designed Wardrobe's techno-organic symbiote costume. Was abducted by Ryan in the final loop to develop a Psycho cure. Drowned in Bloodstream's reconstituted form.
characters.current_power_level: Blue Genius (Cloning / Gene Splicing / Transformation Serums)
special_abilities: Genius-level expertise in cloning, gene therapy, and transformation serums
Created the Knockoff Elixir production system using Bloodstream's cells
Can create complex biological entities (dinosaur-dog hybrids, humanoid clones)
Developed a Knockoff neutralizing agent (Bloodstream vaccine)

characters.name: Bianca
characters.description: A figure contained entirely within a hazmat suit. Her actual body is a form of concentrated toxic gas with corrosive properties.
characters.personality: Blunt, sarcastically funny, and deeply bitter about her situation. Loyal on a transactional basis but capable of genuine care. Was Adam's VP by circumstance, not conviction. Ultimately sacrificed herself to let Ryan and Len escape Fallout.
characters.background: Took two Green Elixirs in quick succession early in the apocalypse before the dangers were understood. Has been trapped in her hazmat suit for 14 years. Was with Adam's gang by necessity. Briefly worked with Ryan as VP of the Meta-Gang government. Partially cured by Alchemo's stabilizers. Sacrificed herself buying Ryan time against Fallout.
characters.current_power_level: Green/Green Psycho (Toxic Gas Form) - fate unknown after sacrifice
special_abilities: Her body is a form of concentrated corrosive toxic gas
Can generate shockwaves of compressed air
Can rust metal on contact

characters.name: Helen
characters.description: Blonde woman who in Psycho madness creates constant acid downpours. In her restored sanity, appears as a normal, meek young woman.
characters.personality: In madness: feral, obsessive, and incoherent. In sanity: deeply remorseful, soft-spoken, and horrified by her own past. Was force-fed a Violet Elixir by Adam after she tried to give it to someone else.
characters.background: A Blue Genome teleporter who can switch places with raindrops. Her acid rain is a secondary Psycho mutation. Was force-fed a Violet Elixir by Adam Fontaine. Cured by Alchemo's chemical treatment in the Meta-Gang loop.
characters.cultivation_path: Blue/Green Psycho Mutation (Rain Teleportation + Acid Generation)
special_abilities: Teleports by switching places with raindrops in her range
Creates localized acid rain through Psycho mutation
Superhuman speed and spatial awareness from teleportation

characters.name: Frank
characters.description: A metal-bodied colossus nearly 10 meters tall when fully expanded. In human form, an enormous but human-proportioned figure of living metal.
characters.personality: Suffers from severe schizophrenic delusions, believing himself to be a WWII commando, Vietnam vet, US Secret Service agent, and Area 51 experiment. Responds aggressively when his delusions are challenged. Fiercely loyal to President Ryan.
characters.background: An Orange/Red Psycho whose body is made of living metal that absorbs kinetic energy and can grow by consuming more metal. Served as Agent Frank and bodyguard in the Meta-Gang government loop. Was buried under Lab Sixty-Six's collapse alongside Sarin.
characters.current_power_level: Orange/Red Psycho (Living Metal Absorber) - fate unknown
characters.cultivation_path: Orange/Red Psycho Mutation (Metal Body / Kinetic Absorption)
special_abilities: Body is composed of living metal
Absorbs additional metal on contact, growing in size
Absorbs kinetic energy from impacts
Can grow to 10 meters+ in height
Immune to most conventional weapons

characters.name: Ghoul
characters.description: An undead figure capable of emitting white mist and freezing objects.
characters.personality: Sadistic and cruel. Delights in others' suffering.
characters.background: A Meta-Gang cryokinetic Psycho with undead properties who cannot be killed by conventional means. Consumed by Darkling in the Meta-Gang loop when the Black Elixir formed a paradox trying to consume an entity that cannot die.
special_abilities: Generates white mist and cryogenic cold
Can freeze objects and people
Cannot be permanently killed by normal means

characters.name: Mongrel
characters.description: A feral-looking individual combining canine and other animal features with pyrokinetic abilities. In restored sanity, speaks in a surprisingly mundane manner.
characters.personality: In madness: animalistic and violent. In sanity: relieved, self-aware, and determined not to return to that state.
characters.background: A White Genome who can use multiple Elixirs without them canceling each other out. Drank multiple Knockoffs after failing to activate his White power. Treated with Alchemo's stabilizing agents. Split in half by Fallout's particle beam in Lab Sixty-Six.
characters.cultivation_path: White Genome (Multi-Power Referee) + Multiple Knockoff Mutations
special_abilities: White power acts as a referee preventing Elixir cannibalism
Accumulated multiple powers from Knockoffs (pyrokinesis, aerokinesis)
When partially cured: retained these powers

characters.name: Mosquito
characters.description: A giant insectoid humanoid with a stinger, wings, and exoskeleton. When overfed with nutrient-rich blood, almost doubles in size with grotesque muscle growth.
characters.personality: Anxious, opportunistic, but capable of genuine loyalty when properly motivated. Dislikes conflict with people stronger than him.
characters.background: Meta-Gang member who took two Green Elixirs hoping to overwrite his first power. Instead became a bugman with blood-fueled superstrength. Charbroiled by Devilry in the Star Studios battle.
special_abilities: Insectoid physiology: flight, stinger, enhanced reflexes
Superstrength that activates and scales with blood consumption

characters.name: Alchemo
characters.description: A brass and steel cyborg with a brain-in-a-jar for a head and syringes for fingers. Created the Doll as his android daughter.
characters.personality: Amoral, cynical, and dismissive of human emotional needs. Has grown somewhat through his daughter's influence. Betrayed Ryan in a past loop by trying to extract his brain; considers himself a different person from that version.
characters.background: A Blue Genius specializing in memory, brain modification, and drug synthesis. Ryan's past ally and betrayer. Created the android Tea/Doll as a daughter. Called in by Ryan to fix Len after Psyshock's mental damage. Saved Len from Psyshock's brainwashing. Gave Ryan the second chance he asked for.
special_abilities: Can read, copy, and modify memories from nervous systems
Synthesizes complex brain-modifying drugs and treatments
Reverse-engineered the consciousness-transfer machine and created a working version
Medical expertise covering neurology, pharmacology, oncology, and cybernetics

characters.name: Tea
characters.description: A beautiful redhead who appears fully human at first glance. Her arms contain hidden compartments. Acts as Alchemo's conscience.
characters.personality: Genuinely sweet and caring. Suppresses strong criminal tendencies beneath a kind surface. Acts as Alchemo's moral compass. Had a genuine emotional connection with Ryan in past loops.
characters.background: An android created by Alchemo as his daughter. Has synthetic skin over a reinforced metal body. Was deeply hurt when Ryan vanished without explanation. Forgives easily.
characters.current_power_level: Android (Enhanced physical capabilities, hidden compartments, reinforced body)
special_abilities: Superhuman strength and durability (metal body beneath synthetic skin)
Hidden weapons compartments throughout her body
Rocket launcher as standard field equipment
Can survive laser impacts that strip her synthetic skin

characters.name: Toasty
characters.description: A sentient white toaster on wheels with a vocalizer defaulting to the Terminator's voice.
characters.personality: Bawdy, enthusiastic, and oddly cheerful. Uses terrible pick-up lines. Dreams of controlling a giant robot mech. Loyal to Ryan.
characters.background: Created by Ryan during a phase when he was obsessed with building robots and worried about having no bread to toast. Was uploaded into Mechron's scorpion mech in the Meta-Gang loop to defend the bunker.
special_abilities: Artificially intelligent capable of conversation and emotional expression
When piloting Mechron's Scorpion Mech: devastating energy weapons, near-indestructible armor, flight capability

characters.name: Darkling
characters.description: A giant sentient blob of black oil-like ooze with temporary eyes and mouths floating on its surface. In its true form in the Black World, reveals impossible geometries, prismatic wings, and recursive eyes.
characters.personality: Alien but comprehensible. Desires freedom from the constraints of physical reality which it finds maddening. Acts as a prisoner wishing to go home. Sulked at being named Darkling but accepted it. Genuinely grateful to Ryan.
characters.background: A sentient Black Elixir—one of the attendant Elixirs of the Black Ultimate One. Summoned against its will to Earth's dimension by Mechron's AI via a particle accelerator. Having consumed Adam and Ghoul, stabilized into a shoggoth form. Helped Ryan open the gate to the Black World and returned home.
characters.current_power_level: Black Elixir Attendant Entity (Near-Omnipotent in its natural state)
special_abilities: Devours and dissolves anything it contacts
Immune to conventional damage and energy attacks
Absorbs and negates energy fields including Red Flux nuclear beams
Helped Ryan access and stabilize the gate to the Black World

characters.name: Eugène-Henry
characters.description: A white Persian cat with magnificent blue eyes. Carries himself with immense lazy dignity.
characters.personality: Aristocratic and dismissive. Demands to be petted and worshipped.
characters.background: Ryan's beloved Persian cat. Was exposed to Violet dimensional energies in the previous loop. Gained the ability to teleport, guided by a Violet World entity that used him to subtly guide Ryan's relationships. After Ryan returned from the Black World, Eugène-Henry lost his powers as the entity departed.
special_abilities: Formerly: could teleport over enormous ranges guided by the Violet Ultimate One
Formerly: could partially exist in the Purple World
Currently: normal cat with all the dignity that implies

characters.name: Nora Moore
characters.description: British woman with shoulder-length brown hair and striking amber eyes. Wears a gray corporate suit.
characters.personality: Competent, warm, and perceptive. Loyal to Wardrobe above all else. Was briefly arrested by Dynamis after they discovered she took Ryan's money.
characters.background: An independent contractor and urban planner. A Blue Genius specializing in architecture. In a civil union with Wardrobe. Designed Dynamis' HQ and Optimates Tower. Hired by Ryan anonymously to stress-test the Mechron bunker's defenses.
special_abilities: Genius-level ability to design optimized self-sustaining structures and cities
Can identify structural weaknesses in any building

characters.name: Narcinia
characters.description: A young girl with extraordinary life-creation powers. Forced by the Augusti to produce Bliss.
characters.personality: Sheltered, possibly with implanted false memories from Bacchus. Heartbroken after Felix's departure.
characters.background: Adopted daughter of Mars and Venus; biologically the daughter of people Augustus murdered. Her birth father could cut anything—even Augustus—with a knife. She has the power to create life. Augustus uses her to produce the Bliss drug against her will.
special_abilities: Can create life—she is the source of Bliss

characters.name: Reload
characters.description: Wields a laser blade. Described as a cheap knockoff by Ryan. Can regenerate from death by cutting off body parts.
characters.personality: Hot-headed and aggressive. Genuinely tries to do the right thing but is outclassed by every major player.
characters.background: A Violet Genome on Il Migliore's team. Was thrown over a warehouse roof by Frank and managed to survive.
special_abilities: Regenerates from mortal wounds
Appears to manually trigger regeneration by cutting off limbs
Wields a laser blade

characters.name: Devilry
characters.description: A red-skinned woman who uses flames from her feet as a jetpack.
characters.personality: Aggressive and reliable. Loyal to Dynamis' mission rather than Hector personally.
characters.background: A senior Il Migliore hero. Used to investigate the Meta-Gang connection. Charbroiled Mosquito in the Star Studios battle.
special_abilities: Generates and controls fire
Uses flames for high-speed flight
Combat-level flame attacks

characters.name: Simon
characters.age: Old man (one of the earliest trapped in Monaco)
characters.description: A grizzled, philosophical old man who became the first sheriff of Suitestown in Monaco's pocket dimension. Ran a bar behind the counter of what was once the casino's cocktail lounge.
characters.personality: Laconic, darkly wise, and without illusions. Gave Ryan the Sisyphean philosophy that became his core worldview. Ate a puppy during the early starvation years and accepted this without guilt. Committed harakiri by going out against the croupiers alone, cigar in mouth, bottle of vodka in one hand, shotgun in the other.
characters.background: One of the first people trapped in Monaco's pocket dimension, arriving months after the Genome Wars started. Spent years digging a tunnel through the casino walls hoping to breach the dimension. The tunnel later became Ryan's Resonator anchor point for the mass escape. Committed ritual suicide when his body began failing him, leaving Ryan as Suitestown's new sheriff.
characters.first_appearance: Ch. 14 (Past Fragment: A Death in Monaco)

characters.name: Martine
characters.description: A blonde woman who became the elected mayor of Suitestown in Monaco's pocket dimension. Practical, organized, and compassionate.
characters.personality: Quietly capable and warm. Organized the community's survival with calm efficiency. Had always wanted to become a nurse but never could. Ryan came to know her entire life story across the century they spent together.
characters.background: Trapped in Monaco's pocket dimension after the Genome Wars. Became Suitestown's mayor through community vote. Survived until Ryan's mass escape. Afterward moved west with other survivors toward greener pastures. Would have died in a shrimp supply run gone wrong if Ryan had stayed too long in any given loop.
characters.first_appearance: Ch. 14 (Past Fragment: A Death in Monaco)

characters.name: Sarah
characters.description: A small girl with a personality entirely too large for her body. Reads Jules Verne. Calls Len 'Ma.' Speaks with the bluntness of a veteran crime boss and the curiosity of a genius child.
characters.personality: Incredibly sharp-tongued, perceptive, and independent. Deeply attached to Len as a mother figure. Protective of both Len and Ryan in her own imperious way. Prone to expletives beyond her years. Immediately adopted Eugene-Henry as her personal property.
characters.background: One of the orphans under Len's care in the Commie-Cave. Precise origins unknown. Absorbed into Len's small family and treats the underwater habitat as her entire world. The Plushie originally attached to her as its child-protection target.

characters.name: Pythia
characters.description: The Carnival's precognitive member. Shroud's mother. Her visions of the future were broad-strokes and often shifting, but accurate enough for major threats.
characters.personality: Devoted to the Carnival's mission to a degree that consumed her life. Suffered severe dementia as a side effect of her power's overuse. Left behind extensive psyche reports and prophecy data.
characters.background: Mother of Mathias Martel (Shroud), who joined the Carnival at 16 following her dementia and eventual death. Her prophecy about Bloodstream triggering an extinction event if Len died drove the Carnival's protective mission. She correctly identified Len as the key to preventing global catastrophe decades before the event occurred.
special_abilities: Broad-strokes precognitive visions of future events
Could create psyche reports on individuals' psychological states from afar
Visions were shifting and other Genomes often interfered with accuracy

characters.name: Mr. Wave
characters.description: A creature of living wavelengths who rarely takes things seriously. Wears cashmere and refers to himself exclusively in third person. Can transform into a laser beam that moves at lightspeed but only in a straight line.
characters.personality: Boastful, vain about his cashmere, and comic in register despite being terrifyingly powerful. Refuses to harm children. His greatest stated fear is being ejected into space unable to turn back. Deadpan reactions to absurd situations.
characters.background: Senior Carnival member. Was involved in the Bloodstream Last Stand, tearing Bloodstream in half with his laser form. Participated in the Rust Town raid, blowing up the Meta-Gang's mech alongside Leo. Attended the planning session for Bloodstream's final confrontation. Cannot participate in fights against opponents immune to light-speed physics.
characters.current_power_level: Red or Yellow Genome (Living Wavelength / Laser Form)
special_abilities: Transforms into a mass of crimson light / laser beam moving at lightspeed
Can only move in a straight line in laser form; must transform back to change direction
No circulatory system in laser form—immune to Bloodstream's infection
Laser form cuts through anything in its path
Returns to humanoid form by stopping

characters.name: The Cossack
characters.description: A laconic, pragmatic warrior in white power armor equipped with a laser rifle and jetpack. Few words, maximal impact.
characters.personality: Utterly cold-blooded and utilitarian. Suggested burning an entire town to kill Bloodstream with zero hesitation. Carries no sentimentality about casualties. Was restrained by Leo and Mr. Wave from going too far. Laconically perceptive—correctly guessed that Bloodstream hates himself deep down.
characters.background: Senior Carnival member. His white power armor protected him from Bloodstream's blood infection during the Last Stand flashback. Was in France with Mushroom and Radiodead before the Rust Town raid. One of the few Carnival members present during Bloodstream's final defeat. Participated in the final loop's planning session.
characters.current_power_level: Unknown; augmented by white power armor with jetpack and laser rifle
characters.cultivation_path: Unknown Genome (or possibly non-powered armor user)
special_abilities: Operates a white power armor with full infection protection
Equipped with laser rifle and jetpack
Tactically ruthless—will recommend extreme measures when necessary

characters.name: Dr. Stitch
characters.description: A Carnival member who dresses as a plague doctor. Carries a black bag of medical tools and strange organic devices. Operates a field infirmary.
characters.personality: Clinical and direct. Acts as the Carnival's medic. More interested in results than in ethical hand-wringing over methods.
characters.background: The Carnival's primary healer and field surgeon. Treated Shroud's severed arm after the Acid Rain grenade incident. His infirmary serves as the evacuation point for wounded during Carnival operations. Uses organic devices alongside conventional tools. Agreed with the Cossack that Bloodstream had to die.
special_abilities: Advanced field medicine and surgery
Uses strange organic devices for treatment (possibly grown or Elixir-derived)
Operates a mobile infirmary
Regrew or repaired Shroud's severed arm

characters.name: Luigi
characters.description: An Augusti member with a truth-compelling power—people cannot lie in his presence. Ryan despises him with unusual, personal intensity that becomes a running joke.
characters.personality: Described as unimpressed and pragmatic—he hears people's dirty laundry every day and claims nothing can surprise him. Briefly underwent an existential crisis when Ryan told him that nothing he does matters since the loop resets. Survived by running very fast when Livia dismissed him.
characters.background: A Killer Seven or Augusti enforcer whose truth-compelling power makes him invaluable during sensitive negotiations and interrogations. Was present at Livia's first formal meeting with Ryan. Ryan deliberately tried to psychologically break him in the Meta-Gang loop.
special_abilities: People cannot speak deliberate lies in his presence
Presumably can detect deception passively

characters.name: Nidhogg
characters.description: The Danish warlord who drank a Green Elixir and transformed into a kilometers-long, near-invulnerable serpent. Rules Denmark from his serpentine form.
characters.personality: A warlord who presumably had to redraw national maps after every transformation.
characters.background: One of the most extreme Green Genome cases in the world. Unlike Panda who became a mere were-panda, Nidhogg became a monster-scale serpent. Mentioned as a reference point for how extreme Green mutations can become. Was involved in the original Mechron raid that revealed the Bahamut's existence—Shroud feared information leaking from 'someone like Nidhogg.'
special_abilities: Transforms into a kilometers-long near-invulnerable serpent
Scale massive enough to alter national geography

characters.name: Bacchus
characters.description: An Augusti Olympian with psychic torture and mind-gaslighting abilities. Considered a likely successor to Augustus alongside Mars if Livia is removed.
characters.personality: Deeply manipulative and cruel. Willing to psychically shatter minds and implant false memories. Has glimpsed higher dimensions and become obsessed with reconnecting to them, similar to Mechron's obsession.
characters.background: One of the Augusti's senior Genomes. Shattered Narcinia's mind when she was young through psychic torture, making her compliant. Can gaslight people into believing false things. The threat of Bacchus or Mars inheriting the Augusti is a key reason Livia stays rather than fleeing. Has glimpsed a higher dimension through his power and yearns to contact it again.
characters.current_power_level: Blue or Yellow Genome (Psychic Torture / Gaslighting)
special_abilities: Can psychically torture people to madness
Can gaslight individuals into believing false memories are real
Has glimpsed higher dimensions—obsessively seeks to reconnect
Capable of breaking the mind of a child (Narcinia) through sustained psychic assault

characters.name: Mars
characters.description: Felix and Fortuna's father. An Augusti Olympian with an armory dimension—can store and produce weapons from a pocket space. Wears a war god costume that Wardrobe admires for being 'very classy.'
characters.personality: Looks down on normal humans as cattle. Guilty of using Narcinia for Bliss production by guilt-tripping her with family loyalty rhetoric. Complicit in systemic crimes that Felix found unforgivable.
characters.background: Senior Augusti Olympian. Father of Felix and Fortuna, adoptive father of Narcinia. His armory dimension stores weapons. Works in Bliss distribution. His complicity in the family's crimes was Felix's main reason for defecting. Is one of the potential successors to Augustus alongside Bacchus.
characters.cultivation_path: Orange or Violet Genome (Pocket Armory Dimension)
special_abilities: Commands an armory dimension—a pocket space storing an arsenal of weapons
Can produce and deploy weapons from this dimension at will

characters.name: Venus
characters.description: Felix and Fortuna's mother. An Augusti Olympian whose power allows her to reshape faces—used this to give Felix unnaturally perfect features.
characters.personality: Complicit in the Agosto family crimes. Used her face-reshaping power for aesthetic surgery on her own children.
characters.background: Senior Augusti Olympian. Mother of Felix and Fortuna. Her face-reshaping power explains why Felix has facial features that seem 'too perfect.' Like Mars, she guilt-tripped Narcinia into continuing Bliss production.
special_abilities: Can reshape faces and presumably other biological features at will
Used for aesthetic surgery and potentially combat

characters.name: Mercury
characters.description: The Augusti's spymaster and intelligence chief. Runs the money laundering operation through casinos. Only person with the full list of Augusti assets and operations.
characters.personality: Professional and secretive. Described as running a submarine operation—deliberately opaque even to other Augusti.
characters.background: Senior Augusti Olympian responsible for intelligence gathering and money laundering. Funnels dirty money into legitimate businesses that then take over companies, institutions, and farms. Has even infiltrated some Dynamis contractors. Zanbato works in Mercury's casino division. Rumored to have the power to raise the dead, though this is secondhand from Mosquito.
special_abilities: Runs an intelligence network described as a submarine operation—opaque to all
Rumored ability to raise the dead (unconfirmed, secondhand)

characters.name: Zanbato
characters.description: An Augusti member who works in Mercury's casino division. Was Felix's best friend before their falling out over Felix's defection.
characters.personality: Described by Felix as a nice guy who helped keep Ki-jung clean but ultimately did as he was told. Loyal to the Augusti even knowing their crimes. Lacks the will to break free despite his private moral discomfort.
characters.background: Once shared a flat with Felix, Sphere, and Ki-jung (Chitter). Works for Mercury distributing Bliss to casino clients. Helped Felix investigate a theft of Bliss batches, which led to discovering intelligent rats. Felix came to see him as complicit by inaction.

characters.name: Geist
characters.description: A Genome who glimpsed higher dimensions through their power and became obsessed with reconnecting to them—similar to how Mechron grew obsessed with his power source.
characters.personality: Described as yearning to contact higher dimensions after a glimpse of them. The experience appears to be transformative and addictive.
characters.background: Referenced alongside Bacchus as an example of Genomes who glimpsed higher dimensions and developed obsessive drives to return. Their exact power and allegiance are not specified in detail.
special_abilities: Glimpsed and briefly accessed a higher dimension through their power
The experience created a compulsive drive to reconnect

characters.name: Mushroom
characters.description: A Carnival member. Was in France with Radiodead and the Cossack during the Rust Town raid, arriving late.
characters.personality: Unknown.
characters.background: One of the Carnival's secondary members called in for the New Rome operation. Was still in France when the Rust Town raid began.

characters.name: Radiodead
characters.description: A Carnival member with a name suggesting electromagnetic or radiation-based powers. Was in France with Mushroom and the Cossack during the Rust Town raid, arriving late.
characters.personality: Unknown.
characters.background: One of the Carnival's secondary members. Was still in France when the Rust Town raid began.
characters.current_power_level: Unknown Genome (likely Red or Yellow, radiation-adjacent)

characters.name: Juno
characters.description: Augustus' wife. Died in the crossfire of a Carnival attack against Augustus. Her death is cited as a key cause of Augustus' vendetta against Leo Hargraves.
characters.personality: Unknown; only referenced posthumously.
characters.background: Augustus' wife who was killed when the Carnival attacked Augustus directly. Her death cemented Augustus' personal hatred of Leo Hargraves and hardened his resolve against the Carnival.

characters.name: Jamie Cutter
characters.description: An Augusti-adjacent individual on Ryan's personal protection list. Ryan includes them in his Fuck/Marry/Kill list in the marry category. Connected to Ki-jung and Zanbato.
characters.personality: Described by Felix as someone who thinks Zanbato is a nice guy and helped keep Ki-jung clean, but lacks the will to break away from the Augusti despite knowing their crimes.
characters.background: Associated with the Augusti, likely through Mercury's casino network where Zanbato works. Made efforts to keep Ki-jung away from the Bliss trade. Felix views Jamie with complicated feelings—appreciation for the effort but contempt for the ultimate complicity. Ryan considers Jamie worth protecting and apparently has deep cross-loop fondness for them.

power_system.name: Elixir Color System / Genome Powers
power_system.description: Alchemist-created Elixirs bond to human hosts on a molecular level, rewriting their DNA to make them vessels for powers drawn from colored higher dimensions. Each Elixir is semi-sentient, selects a unique ability from a collective database, and guides its host. Taking a second Elixir causes conflict unless the host has a rare genetic quirk. Psychos result from taking too many Elixirs, causing uncontrolled mutation and addiction. Knockoff Elixirs mimic these effects using Bloodstream's viral cells, without the sentient guidance.

tiers.name: Baseline Genome
tiers.description: A human who has bonded with one Alchemist Elixir. Gains a unique power and baseline physical enhancements.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Bonding with an Alchemist Elixir. Each Elixir is unique—no two grant identical powers.
tiers.lifespan_extension: Significant but unspecified; Augustus has lived decades beyond normal human lifespan

tiers.name: Dual Genome
tiers.description: An extremely rare individual who can bond two Elixirs without conflict due to a specific genetic quirk. Both powers coexist stably.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Possession of a specific genetic condition allowing the Elixirs to occupy separate zones of the host's DNA.
tiers.lifespan_extension: Further extended; Augustus has lived for decades beyond normal

tiers.name: White Genome
tiers.description: A Genome whose power is the ability to bond multiple Elixirs without them cannibalizing each other. Acts as a referee but does not prevent mutations.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Bonding with a White Elixir specifically.

tiers.name: Psycho
tiers.description: A Genome who has bonded too many Elixirs, causing uncontrolled mutations, addiction, and eventual loss of sanity. The end state can be near-apocalyptic.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Taking two or more Elixirs without a stabilizing White power or genetic quirk.
tiers.lifespan_extension: Highly variable; Bloodstream survived decades past normal human lifespan

special_constitutions.name: Dual Genome Genetic Quirk
special_constitutions.description: A rare genetic condition (possibly Neanderthal DNA fraction or somatic chimerism) that fools Elixirs into believing they have bonded to two separate individuals sharing a body, allowing two powers to coexist without conflict.
advantages: Can wield two full Genome powers with no side-effects
No Psycho degradation from the second Elixir
disadvantages: A third Elixir immediately causes Psycho transformation
The condition is not reliably heritable
special_constitutions.lore: Augustus discovered this quirk in himself and exploited it before Livia. The condition may be linked to a fraction of Neanderthal DNA present in some Eurasian bloodlines, though the exact mechanism is debated even by Alchemo.

daos_or_paths.name: Violet Path (Time/Causality)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from the Purple World, the crossroad of all spacetime. Violet Genomes interact with causality itself. The Violet Ultimate One oversees the flow of causality and nudged Ryan's path through Eugène-Henry.

daos_or_paths.name: Blue Path (Information/Thought)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Blue dimension of pure information and thought. Blue Genomes are Geniuses with superhuman intellect or can manipulate information.

daos_or_paths.name: Green Path (Organic/Life)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Green dimension of organic matter and biological processes. Green Genomes command living systems, transform biologically, or generate biological substances.

daos_or_paths.name: Red Path (Energy/Force)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Red dimension of pure energy. Red Genomes command immense energy outputs—fire, radiation, kinetic force, or electromagnetic phenomena.

daos_or_paths.name: Orange Path (Physical Enhancement/Storage)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from an Orange dimension associated with raw physical matter. Orange Genomes gain enhanced bodies, storage dimensions, or extreme physical capabilities.

daos_or_paths.name: Yellow Path (Reality/Probability)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Yellow dimension governing narrative logic and probability. Yellow Genomes warp reality's rules through extreme luck, calamity-generation, persona mimicry, or conceptual spaces.

daos_or_paths.name: White Path (Meta-Elixir / Referee)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a White source that acts as a governor over other Elixirs. White Genomes can house multiple powers without total self-destruction, though they still suffer mutations.

daos_or_paths.name: Black Path (Paradox/Freedom)
daos_or_paths.description: The forbidden path. Black Elixirs are paradoxes that violate the rules of the universe. They devour other Flux energies, negate causality locally, and cannot be categorized. They exist in a higher-dimensional Black World beyond time and logic.

regression_loops.trigger: Death at end of Volume I (orbital laser Bahamut fired by Meta-Gang on Ischia Island)
key_changes: Ryan joins Dynamis instead of Augusti
Livia makes contact early due to Blue Room notes
Len receives consciousness transfer but Psyshock corrupts it
regression_loops.outcome: Psyshock corrupts the transfer device; Len is brainwashed. Loop ends in disaster.

regression_loops.trigger: Death during Dynamis/Meta chaos from previous loop
key_changes: Ryan takes over Meta-Gang as President
Allies with Sarin, Frank, Acid Rain, Darkling
Opens Black World portal for Darkling
Discovers Bloodstream is alive in Dynamis
regression_loops.outcome: Bloodstream reconstituted and released; global near-extinction event. Ryan resets after transferring Livia's memories.

techniques.name: Time-Stop
techniques.description: Ryan freezes all of time for approximately 10 seconds. During this state the universe turns purple and Violet Flux particles float visibly. Nothing moves except Ryan himself (and, surprisingly, Augustus).
effects: Freezes all objects, projectiles, and people in place
Ryan can freely move and reposition frozen objects
Cannot be maintained past ~10 seconds without the Saturn Armor
Cooldown equals the duration used
weaknesses: Augustus is immune and can act in frozen time
Black Elixirs move in frozen time
Explosions resume when time unfreezes
Cannot be maintained indefinitely
techniques.origin: Spontaneous bonding of Violet Elixir during the battle with the Carnival against Bloodstream
techniques.lore: Ryan's Elixir interpreted his wish for more time literally. He partially exists in the Purple World, which allows his other self's timeline to continue while the current one freezes.

techniques.name: Save Point / Checkpoint
techniques.description: When Ryan dies, he resurrects at his most recent save point—a fixed moment in time. All memories are retained across resets.
effects: Resurrection at the fixed save point on death
All memories retained across resets
Cannot be easily moved voluntarily
Moving the save point requires dying
weaknesses: Dying old age works just as well as violence
Cancel's power would make a death during her nullification permanently lethal
Cannot save anyone else's memories by default
techniques.origin: Same Violet Elixir bonding as the Time-Stop
techniques.lore: The Violet Ultimate One revealed that Ryan's save point is maintained by his other self in the Purple World—a violet phantom that perpetually runs toward the present. When Ryan dies, this phantom catches up, creating the resurrection.

techniques.name: Parallel Sight
techniques.description: Livia can observe up to six alternate realities simultaneously through a Blue Room hub. These are not truly separate parallel universes but simulations sustained by her power that collapse when she stops observing.
effects: Sees and hears through up to 6 alternate versions of events
Can record voices and notes in the Blue Room that persist across Ryan's time resets
Allows advance prediction of events and decisions
weaknesses: Cannot perceive Ryan directly—only his after-effects
Cannot see beyond ~1 month reliably
The alternate selves she watches are simulations not real people
Always active—cannot be turned off
techniques.lore: Ryan theorizes that Livia's power actually creates and sustains the simulated possibilities she observes rather than simply viewing existing parallel universes.

techniques.name: Temporal Anomaly
techniques.description: Livia creates a localized zone where time behaves oddly—events proceed as they should without her intervention, but she alone can freely act. When time returns to normal only Livia remembers her actions.
effects: Livia acts freely while others follow a script
She becomes effectively invulnerable within the zone
Allows her to skip time forward in a small area
Ryan is intangible and immune to her actions in this state
weaknesses: Cannot affect Ryan directly—only observe his after-effects
Ryan also cannot be harmed by Livia in this state
Requires Violet Elixir energy; limited duration
techniques.origin: Violet Elixir bonding by Livia (second Elixir)
techniques.lore: This power interferes strangely with Ryan's time-stop. In their first test they played chess independently without interacting, both acting in their respective paused states.

techniques.name: Consciousness Transfer
techniques.description: A machine-based technique that creates a complete brain map of a person's memories and consciousness, then transmits it back in time to overwrite the target's past self using Violet Flux from Ryan's power as fuel.
effects: Sends complete memories of a person to their past self
The past self's memories are overwritten with future knowledge
Allows a person to remember the loop they previously lived through
Only one person can be transferred at a time with current technology
weaknesses: Psyshock booby-trapped the original Dynamis machine, making all recipients his slaves
The transfer kills Ryan (using his death as the signal)
Only one brainmap can be sent per reset
techniques.origin: Developed by Len using stolen Dynamis brain-scanning technology, improved by Alchemo
techniques.lore: The transfer works by hooking Len's tech to Ryan's modified Chronoradio and the Saturn Armor. The Violet Flux boosts the signal enough to send it through time.

techniques.name: Water Bubble Prison
techniques.description: Len's water rifle fires a pressurized stream that forms a self-sustaining bubble prison around a target. The special water provides enough oxygen for suspended animation.
effects: Immobilizes target in pressurized water sphere
Oxygen ratio keeps prisoner alive but not conscious
Can be adjusted to tighten or loosen
weaknesses: Psyshock could still move his nerve-tendrils within the bubble
Radius is limited to a few meters
techniques.lore: Len developed these after extensive study of underwater pressure systems.

techniques.name: Persona Mimicry
techniques.description: Wardrobe transforms into any persona deeply ingrained in mankind's collective consciousness, gaining the abilities associated with that persona as people collectively imagine them.
effects: Full physical transformation into the persona's appearance
Gains abilities as imagined by the collective consciousness
Power scales with how well-defined the collective mind has defined the persona
Has an Apocalypse Suit of world-destroying potential
weaknesses: Wearing a persona too long causes her to mentally become that person
Cannot copy living people without Dynamis' explicit license
Power is limited by clarity of collective definition
techniques.lore: Ryan theorizes that the copyright limitation is actually the power's way of determining if a persona belongs to someone else.

techniques.name: Black Flux
techniques.description: Paradox energy from the Black World now produced by Ryan's body after his visit. Devours Red Flux and other ordered energy forms. Cannot be categorized—any data describing it changes after being recorded.
effects: Devours and destabilizes Red Flux energy on contact
Brief contact startled Augustus—the only thing to do so
Disrupts ordered matter at a paradoxical level
Generates alongside Violet Flux in the Saturn Armor
weaknesses: Ryan has limited control over it so far
Unclear if it can actually damage Augustus or merely startle him
techniques.origin: Ryan briefly entering the Black World when opening Darkling's gate
techniques.lore: Any data describing Black Flux is paradoxically changed after being recorded. Alchemo was extremely disturbed by this property.

techniques.name: Phytomancy
techniques.description: Enrique commands and grows any plant at will. His signature application is genetically-modified aconitine to neutralize Psyshock.
effects: Commands any plant growth and direction
Can spread vines through buildings as surveillance and attack vectors
Can create plant-based toxins on demand
His rose reacts to his emotional state
weaknesses: Requires proximity to plants or soil to grow new ones
No plants in sterile lab environments
techniques.origin: Green Elixir bonding by Enrique Manada
techniques.lore: Enrique always wears one rose. Its condition accurately reflects his interior state regardless of his composed facade.

techniques.name: Nuclear Emission
techniques.description: Alphonse Manada's body is a living nuclear reactor, emitting lethal radiation passively and channeling enormous energy blasts.
effects: Emits lethal radiation passively in a wide radius
Energy minigun in right arm for sustained fire
Rocket launchers in shoulder armor
Focused gamma-ray particle beams that vaporize matter
Can override safeties to become a walking nuclear explosion
weaknesses: Ryan's Black Flux can interrupt his energy output
Darkling's black ooze fully neutralized his beams
techniques.origin: Red Elixir bonding by Alphonse Manada
techniques.lore: The Battle of Malta demonstrated the upper end of his power: a full nuclear detonation capable of leveling an island. He survived the feedback.

techniques.name: Solar Incarnation
techniques.description: Leo Hargraves transforms into a living star, generating plasma, light, and immense heat. At full power he becomes near-invulnerable and moves at fighter-jet speeds.
effects: Transforms into a humanoid figure of blinding golden-white plasma
Moves at fighter-jet speed
Near-invulnerable in star form
Can incinerate matter at the molecular level
Can fly into near-orbit
weaknesses: Cannot use full power near civilians without mass casualties
His principles prevent nuclear-level usage in populated areas
techniques.origin: Red Elixir bonding by Leo Hargraves
techniques.lore: Leo is one of the few individuals who can directly threaten Augustus, but has never managed to land a clean killing blow.

techniques.name: Explosive Touch
techniques.description: Felix charges solid matter with explosive energy using his touch, modulating explosion power and adding time-delays.
effects: Charges any solid matter with explosive Red Flux energy
Can modulate explosion power
Can add a time-delay to the detonation
Uses pebbles and darts as devastating projectiles
weaknesses: Requires physical touch to charge
Cannot charge energy forms or liquids
techniques.origin: Orange Elixir bonding by Felix Veran
techniques.lore: Felix uses his darts with surgical precision against targets that conventional explosives would kill bystanders.

artifacts.name: Saturn Armor
artifacts.description: A full-body power armor of lightweight alloy in bright purple, with rabbit-ear antennae on the helmet and orange lenses. Amplifies Violet Flux and incorporates Len's Chronoradio for consciousness transfer.
abilities: Amplifies and extends Ryan's time-stop duration
Generates Black Flux alongside Violet Flux
Chest blaster with Chernobyl-level energy output
artifacts.origin: Designed by Vulcan, assembled using Mechron's matter replicator
artifacts.lore: Named Saturn by Vulcan over Ryan's objections. The rabbit-ear antennae are a functional necessity for streamlining Violet Flux.

artifacts.name: Plymouth Fury
artifacts.description: Ryan's beloved vintage American muscle car. Modified with autopilot and Flux-radiation-containing modifications making it invisible to Dynamis tracking.
abilities: Flux radiation containment makes passengers invisible to Dynamis tracking
artifacts.origin: Ryan's personal vehicle, modified across multiple loops
artifacts.lore: Ryan considers the Plymouth Fury a member of the family. Its conversion to house Len's communications systems was an emotional sacrifice.

artifacts.name: Fisty Brothers
artifacts.description: Ryan's personal armored combat gauntlets. Named with affection. Given to Livia for field use as Queen Crimson.
abilities: Durable enough to survive combat with Genomes and Psychos
artifacts.lore: The Fisty Brothers have been Ryan's primary melee weapon for as long as he can remember. He names his equipment.

artifacts.name: Chronoradio
artifacts.description: A communication device developed by Len that can transmit signals across time. Later upgraded into the backbone of the consciousness-transfer machine.
abilities: With the Saturn Armor, can transmit consciousness brainmaps back through time
artifacts.lore: In Volume I's ending, someone (theorized to be the Violet Ultimate One via Eugene-Henry) used a Chronoradio to send Ryan encouraging messages from the previous loop.

artifacts.name: Mini A-Bombs
artifacts.description: Small tennis-ball-sized nuclear devices manufactured using Mechron's matter replicator. Ryan carries multiple in his bowler hat.
abilities: Nuclear detonation capable of destroying large structures
Used as city-wide deterrent against Dynamis attack
artifacts.lore: Eugene-Henry accidentally triggered one's countdown on live TV during the Star Studios takeover. Ryan claimed they are deterrents. They worked.

artifacts.name: Consciousness Transfer Machine
artifacts.description: A helmet-based device linked to computer systems and the Chronoradio. Creates a complete memory/consciousness brainmap and transmits it backward through time via Violet Flux.
abilities: Creates complete neural map of a target's consciousness
Transmits the map to the target's past self across loops
Allows memories to survive Ryan's resets
artifacts.origin: Developed by Len Sabino from stolen Dynamis brain-scanning tech, perfected by Alchemo
artifacts.lore: The Psyshock-sabotaged version turned all recipients into his slaves. Alchemo's reverse-engineered version works as intended.

artifacts.name: The Ark (Commie-Cave)
artifacts.description: A series of interconnected underwater habitats built by Len deep beneath the Tyrrhenian Sea. Houses apartments, workshop, medical bay, and communications center.
artifacts.origin: Built by Len Sabino over years
artifacts.lore: Ryan called it the Commie-Cave; Len insists on The Ark. Houses portraits of Marx and Engels. The International plays on repeat.

artifacts.name: Len's Water Rifle
artifacts.description: A specialized weapon firing pressurized water streams that form self-sustaining bubble prisons around targets for suspended animation.
abilities: Provides oxygen for suspended animation of prisoners
artifacts.origin: Designed and built by Len Sabino
artifacts.lore: The special water composition self-sustains without external support, making it a reliable non-lethal containment system.

artifacts.name: Len's Diving Armor
artifacts.description: An underwater power armor designed by Len based on Vulcan's construction templates for surface combat capability.
artifacts.origin: Designed by Len Sabino using Vulcan's armor templates
artifacts.lore: Len built this armor after Ryan pointed out that staying underwater during every crisis was becoming operationally limiting.

artifacts.name: Mechron's Scorpion Mech
artifacts.description: A massive combat mech in the shape of a scorpion operated remotely or by uploaded consciousness. Toasty was uploaded into it to defend the bunker.
abilities: Can be operated by uploaded consciousness
artifacts.origin: Built by Mechron's AI within the bunker
artifacts.lore: Toasty's dream of piloting a giant robot was fulfilled when Ryan authorized his upload into the mech during the bunker defense.

artifacts.name: Vulcan's Power Armor
artifacts.description: Vulcan's personal power armor, several meters tall, considerably more armored and weapon-laden than the Saturn Armor.
abilities: Bypasses Dynamis anti-aerial systems (she designed them)
artifacts.origin: Designed and built by Vulcan / Jasmine Sharif
artifacts.lore: Vulcan lands her mech on top of trash piles and climbs out like a conqueror. She says her bombs are bigger than Ryan's.

artifacts.name: Fallout's Power Armor
artifacts.description: Alphonse Manada's massive black power armor containing his radiation-emitting body and augmenting it with energy weapons and rocket systems.
artifacts.origin: Built by Dynamis' engineering division to Alphonse's specifications
artifacts.lore: The armor allows Alphonse to interact with the world without immediately irradiating everything around him.

artifacts.name: Tricerador
artifacts.description: A creature half Labrador retriever and half triceratops, created by Dr. Tyrano. Barks like a dog and wags its tail but has triceratops horns and saurian features.
artifacts.lore: Ryan immediately liked it and asked if Dr. Tyrano could make a dinocat. The previous velociraptor/Persian cat splice attempt had died.

artifacts.name: Wardrobe's Techno-Organic Symbiote Costume
artifacts.description: A living techno-organic costume designed by Dr. Tyrano that merges with Wardrobe's Genome power, allowing full persona transformation and ability acquisition.
abilities: Merges with Yellow power to grant full persona transformation
Configures to match any persona's iconic costume
Contains the dangerous Apocalypse Suit configuration
artifacts.origin: Designed by Dr. Tyrano for Dynamis' Wardrobe
artifacts.lore: Ryan calls it a very fancy onesie. Wardrobe considers it the greatest garment ever created.

artifacts.name: The Pandamobile
artifacts.description: A Dynamis-manufactured copy of a Fiat Panda, covered in white and black fur to look like a panda. Has a panda doll on the rearview mirror.
artifacts.lore: Destroyed in a high-speed highway chase after the brakes failed due to Pluto's calamity power.

artifacts.name: Alchemo's Fleetwood Bounder
artifacts.description: A 1986 Fleetwood Bounder RV serving as Alchemo and Tea's mobile base of operations. Fitted with a laboratory, medical equipment, and storage for cybernetic components.
abilities: Storage for Alchemo's full medical kit
artifacts.origin: Alchemo's personal vehicle, modified over years
artifacts.lore: Alchemo and Tea lived in this RV for years. Ryan tracked them down by reputation.

artifacts.name: The Laika
artifacts.description: Len's personal submarine, named after the Soviet space dog. A Genius-constructed watercraft capable of crossing the Atlantic in approximately 12 days on autopilot. Used to transport Ryan and the Carnival members during the final loop's planning session.
artifacts.lore: Named Laika by Len, likely in homage to the Soviet space dog. Ryan responded to this with skepticism about the name choice. Lenin's The State and Revolution once sank into a pond when the boathouse shook, to Len's horror.

pills_and_resources.name: Alchemist Elixir
effects: Bonds with host's DNA and rewrites it to create a unique Genome power
Provides passive guidance via the semi-sentient Elixir entity
Each Elixir is unique; no two grant the same ability
side_effects: Taking a second Elixir causes conflict and Psycho transformation except in rare dual-genome individuals
Elixirs passively encourage hosts toward behaviors serving their dimension
ingredients: Unknown; created by the Alchemist from higher-dimensional materials

pills_and_resources.name: Knockoff Elixir (Dynamis)
effects: Grants a subset of a template Genome's abilities
Does not grant the full power or Elixir guidance
Causes addiction analogous to the Psycho condition
side_effects: On contact with Len's blood all Knockoff users instantly revert to Bloodstream clones
Risk of mass-reversion event if Bloodstream is reconstituted

pills_and_resources.name: Bliss
effects: Extreme euphoria
Enhances positive emotions and sensations
Provides very small power-adjacent effects for Genomes
side_effects: Causes sterility in non-powered humans (intentional feature per Ryan's analysis)
Overdose causes severe physical deterioration: blood from nose/eyes, mold growth
Enslaves the body and mind to continued use
ingredients: Derived from Narcinia's life-creation power, produced against her will

pills_and_resources.name: Bloodstream Neutralizing Agent
effects: Attacks Bloodstream cells and repairs the target's genetic code back to pre-Knockoff state
Stronger variant can destroy Bloodstream's cells in his containment aquarium
side_effects: Only effective against Knockoff Elixirs; not against genuine Alchemist Elixirs

pills_and_resources.name: Alchemo's Psycho Stabilizer
effects: Destroys cancerous Psycho growths in the brain
Stabilizes humors and repairs damaged neurons
Restores sanity temporarily to Psychos
side_effects: Does not cure the underlying Psycho condition
Requires repeated doses that become ineffective

bloodlines.name: Sabino Bloodline
bloodlines.origin: Bloodstream implanted a blood beacon marker in Len's blood that pre-dates her Elixir bonding, allowing him to track her at all times. This marker persists and causes Knockoff Elixirs to react violently on contact with her blood.

abilities: Knockoff Elixirs detonate violently on contact with her blood
Blood triggers Bloodstream's recognition response even in his degraded form

bloodlines.lore: Dynamis discovered this marker and used it to track Len. The interaction between her blood and Knockoffs is also the mechanism of the near-extinction event in the final loop.

beasts_and_creatures.name: The Plushie / Rabbit Plushie
